headSubject: fix(ai): /prep refreshes its indexes on Linux - use python3 when there is no python command (Ubuntu without python-is-python3)
summary: Moved to the Ubuntu notebook (~/repos/NPDev replaces D:\WorkSpace\NPDev; old Windows machine is dead; ScrapForAI setOffline IS on GitHub). Set up: JDK 17 + pwsh 7.4 in ~/.local, Rust 1.99, Tauri libs, libsecret-tools, .claude/settings.json hooks; deleted 19 Dependabot branches (bundle in OutsideRepo/branch-archive). npdev providers key store works on Linux via the desktop keyring (4710fb87, 1b8f9e6d); Manager AI Keys tab (7798391a, cargo check only); /prep python3 fallback (bbd4dfa2). Investigated every AI contact point (/home/marcelo/repos/NPDev/NPDev_General__OutsideRepo/AI_CONTACT_POINTS_2026-10-22.md) and wrote the AI providers unification plan, revision 2 (/home/marcelo/repos/NPDev/NPDev_General__OutsideRepo/AI_PROVIDERS_UNIFICATION_PLAN_2026-10-22.md): Provider -> Model -> Profile -> Binding, local LLM detection, one key owner, one client. Owner decided D5 yes (several keys per provider), D6 no (ai.json per machine).
nextStep: Phase 0 of the AI providers plan: ask the owner if the DeepSeek key in launch-claude.ps1 is revoked (0.1); then remove the literal from launch-claude.ps1 (0.2, or delete it + claude-deepseek-settings.json), teach security-pattern-sweep.py that key shape with a fixture (0.3), delete .continue/ (0.5), file ledger items AIP-0..AIP-6 (0.6). Then Phase 1.1 (ai-config schema). Ask the owner for D1-D4 when they come up.
blocked: Owner: revoke the DeepSeek key (F1); decisions D1 (scrub history), D2 (paid in Prompter / cost cap), D3 (apps started with keys from the store), D4 (custom endpoints as app vendors). OWNER RULE: no long gates on this slow notebook (targeted tests only; CI runs gates after push). sudo apt install python-is-python3 would fix the remaining 'python' calls in gate scripts.
verified: test_providers 20 green + real GNOME Keyring round trip; CLI add/list/test/remove against the real keyring; cargo check of NPDevManager (Linux) green; node --check providers.js; /prep runs on Linux. NOT run: any gate (owner rule), AI Keys tab not seen in a running window, Windows DPAPI path not re-tested.
